text:
Predicates:
RomanceLanguage(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropeanLanguage(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Within(x, y) ::: x is within y.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French ::: the French language.
Spanish ::: the Spanish language.
German ::: the German language.
Basque ::: the Basque language.
Premises:
∀x (RomanceLanguage(x) → IndoEuropeanLanguage(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
∀x (LanguageFamily(x) → ∀y (Within(y, x) → Related(y, y))) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Within(French, RomanceLanguages) ∧ Within(Spanish, RomanceLanguages) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
¬Related(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language y.
Conclusion:
IndoEuropeanLanguage(French) ::: French is an Indo-European language.
